document.abstract: Media companies are under ever-increasing pressure to create and monetize content efficiently by delivering it to viewers wherever they are and on whatever device they wish to use. To meet this challenge, media companies need flexible, composable systems that may be quickly adapted to shifting workflows and a rapidly changing business environment. This article introduces fundamental concepts from the IT domain and describes a way of thinking about a media system that enables flexibility and unlocks a powerful world of composable, dynamic media systems and workflows.

authors.bio: Brad Gilmer is the president of Gilmer & Associates, Inc., and the executive director of the Video Services Forum (VSF) and the Advanced Media Workflow Association (AMWA). Both the VSF and the AMWA received Emmy Awards during Gilmer’s tenure. He is a SMPTE Fellow and a first recipient of the SMPTE Workflow Systems Medal. He was previously employed at Turner Broadcasting System, Atlanta, GA, where he and his staff were responsible for engineering and operations for the Entertainment Division Worldwide. He is an author and an editor and has written many articles on computers and networking for media industry publications.
